Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Revolut's card showcase carousel - a 3D payment card spins 360 degrees as you swipe or pick a color, metallic reflections sweeping its face, with the tier name, blurb and CTA updating underneath.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Black screen: back chevron top, center stage a Revolut card (gradient Plus, black Metal, platinum Ultra, lavender/rose/space-gray Premium finishes) with edges of neighbor cards peeking at the left/right margins. Below: tier name + short blurb, a row of color dots, full-width CTA.

## Motion spec
Pattern: 3D card carousel with flip, ~700ms per transition.
- Horizontal swipe: the current card rotates on its vertical axis toward the swipe (drag-linked, 1:1) and slides off as the neighbor rotates in from the edge - both share one 3D perspective so they read as cards on a ring.
- Release: snaps to the nearest card (spring ~300/20, ~250ms settle).
- Color dot tap: the current card does a full 360 spin (~600ms, ease-in-out), swapping its face finish at the halfway point (back-facing frame), a specular highlight sweeping across during rotation.
- Face finish uses metallic gradients - the highlight band moves as the card rotates, it is not baked in.
- Tier name, blurb, color dots and CTA crossfade to match the settled card (200ms).

## Calibration
- Perspective ~1000px equivalent; flatter perspective kills the 3D read, stronger warps the card edges.
- The card face never mirrors text during the spin - swap the artwork at the 90-degree frame.

## Reduced motion
Cards crossfade with a 60px horizontal slide (250ms); no 3D rotation.

## Don't miss
- Neighbor cards peek at both edges at all times - the carousel affordance dies if the stage shows one card alone.
- The moving highlight is the metallic illusion; without it the finishes read as flat photos.
